name: Genesis Demonstrator Data for Machine Learning
summary: Time-series data from a portable pick-and-place demonstrator, including continuous signals, discrete states, and anomaly labels.

feature_dimensions.summary: 18 features in labeled files; 23 features in the other files
feature_dimensions.counting: Genesis_AnomalyLabels.csv and Genesis_StateMachineLabel.csv have 20 columns including Timestamp and Label. Genesis_lineardrive.csv, Genesis_normal.csv, and Genesis_pressure.csv have 24 columns including Timestamp. Counts include continuous signals, setpoints, and discrete machine states.

attributes.name: Timestamp
attributes.description: Observation time recorded as Unix seconds; the state recording contains two backward clock steps. Preserve source order when inspecting transitions.

attributes.name: MotorData.*, PLC_PRG.*, NVL_*
attributes.description: Discrete state signals for position, gripping, material, and storage mechanisms.

attributes.name: Label
attributes.description: File-dependent target: state-machine IDs 0–8 in Genesis_StateMachineLabel.csv; separate anomaly IDs 0–2 in Genesis_AnomalyLabels.csv. No verified mapping from state IDs to named actions is supplied here.

notes: The column set and presence of the Label column vary by file.
citation: Schuster, R., Moriz, N. and von Birgelen, A. (2018). Genesis demonstrator data for machine learning.
